deploy.preDeployCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "DRF" ]; then python manage.py migrate --noinput; else echo "Skipping migrations for $RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME"; fi'
deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "Worker" ]; then celery -A config worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=1 --max-tasks-per-child=50 --without-gossip --without-mingle --without-heartbeat; else gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 2 --timeout 120; fi'
